target_customer: Developers and companies building sales, recruiting, trust and safety and agent products that need people data
problem: People data is spread across fragmented providers with static records; builders want one API with fresh, resolved identities.
business_model: Usage-based API plus web app, CLI and MCP server (pricing page exists, details not seen)

founders.name: Emmanuel Hernandez
education: LLM research at NYU, no degree listed
founders.background_notes: YC bio: youngest engineer at Wander, worked on AI/ML recommendations; goes by Manny.

founders.name: Kamran Karic
education: Neuroscience research at Tsinghua University, no degree listed
founders.background_notes: YC bio: STEM Olympiad gold medals in math and science in Germany.

competitors.name: People Data Labs
competitors.what: Developer-first person and company data API

technical_complexity.rationale: Indexing billions of profiles with real-time retrieval and identity resolution is data engineering heavy, but built from public sources by two founders.

defensibility.rationale: Crowded category with many alternatives; scraping-based data carries legal risk (Proxycurl shut down July 2025 after a LinkedIn lawsuit per a guide).

market_need_then: Agent builders need people lookup; the 2025 Clearbit enrichment shutdown and Proxycurl closure opened demand for replacements, per roundup guides.

branding.domain_note: A company post dated 2026-02-20 (unverified, blocked from fetching) says Ploid bought ploid.com after about three months of negotiation.

identity.voice_and_tone: developer-direct: 2B+ people, one API, built for AI

branding.brand_signature: Tagline '2B+ people. One API. Built for AI.'

brand_strength.rationale: Search results are dominated by unrelated Ploid biotech entities; no brand-specific press found.

outcome_analysis: Ploid is a two-person Fall 2026 YC company with no outcome yet. It targets a crowded enrichment market but benefits from recent exits of Clearbit and Proxycurl. Key risks are data sourcing legality, accuracy claims that are self-reported, and well-funded competitors.
notes: A search snippet from a ploid-com.pages.dev blog claims an angel round at nearly 700K USD valuation (Jan 2025, amount not stated); the page could not be fetched, so unverified and no round recorded. A JSV Launchpad listing shows Ploid as S26 rather than the F26 shown by YC, and a LinkedIn page says New York; batch and location conflict. Ploid LinkedIn claims 81% accuracy on 1,000 test queries, self-reported. Several unrelated companies named Ploid exist.
